text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three Moroccan commercials rewarded during the advertisement days of French-speaking countries held in Marrakesh.
- Secretary-General of socialist party Union Socialiste des Forces Populaires says King Hassan's August speech opened new prospects for an alternate government.
- Annual book exhibition held in Casablanca saw number of visitors fall sharply compared with last year.
- Morocco and Egypt examine possibility of setting up free trade zone.
